text:
Three statements about a.c. and d.c. currents are given.
1
A d.c. current is in one direction only whilst an a.c. current repeatedly changes
direction.
2
d.c. is the abbreviation for direct current and a.c. is the abbreviation for amplitude
current.
3
An a.c. current is in one direction only whilst a d.c. current repeatedly changes
direction.
Which statements are correct?
A
1 and 2
B
1 only
C
2 and 3
D
3 only
subject: Physics
